gates.name: mypy
gates.caveat: mypy reads only the paths in pyproject.toml's `files` and skips dot-directories during discovery. A new top-level directory is silently unchecked while this stays green — add it to `files` in the same change that creates it.

gates.name: pytest
gates.caveat: Every test here runs against a fake sandbox and fixture transcripts. A green suite proves the control plane's logic, never that `sbx`, `codex`, `gh` or Linear behave the way the fakes say they do — that is what `factory doctor` and a real run are for.
